Subject: Mutual Success Playbook & Close Sprint — proposed draft

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m sharing a lightweight Mutual Success Playbook (MAP) template and a short close-sprint timeline to help us run a focused evaluation and get to a small production pilot quickly.

High-level ask: can you confirm the 3 stakeholder contacts for clinical/ops, engineering, and procurement? Once we have that, we’ll: 
- Populate the playbook (roles & responsibilities)
- Lock success criteria and acceptance tests
- Run a 2-week technical eval (API + sample dataset)
- Aim for an exec decision by the end of the month

I attached a draft GDoc (ClearSprint_MAP_Template_v0.1.gdoc) — it has suggested success metrics, milestones, and a sample evaluation checklist. I also linked starter slide notes for stakeholder brief (I’ll share a polished slide deck after you confirm stakeholders).

Proposed close sprint (rough)
- Week 1 (Jun 15–19): Technical validation + sample ingest
- Week 2 (Jun 22–26): Feature validation, perf checks, and stakeholder demos
- Executive review: Jun 29

Can your team confirm availability for the Week 1 window? If not, we can slide one week.

Thanks — looking forward to co-creating the plan.

—
Jordan Blake

Subject: MAP slides + condensed evaluation checklist

Hi Emma / team —

Thanks Jordan. I uploaded a compact slide pack and a one-page evaluation checklist that maps to the MAP milestones. The checklist is targeted at the engineering and clinical review and includes clear acceptance criteria we can use in the exec review.

What’s in the slide pack (2–3 slides):
- Objective & success metrics (revenue/op and safety-aware metrics)
- Roles & responsibilities (who from Clearwater vs Redwood)
- Sprint timeline (day-by-day asks)
- Acceptance gates (pass/fail, required artifacts)

Evaluation checklist highlights:
- API validation: token auth, payload validation, error handling (pass = all smoke tests green)
- Data handling: sample data redaction, retention policy confirmed (pass = documented)
- Perf: p50/p95 latency targets and max-RPS smoke run (pass = within agreed SLOs)
- Clinical: accuracy spot checks on 50 sample cases (pass = clinical lead sign-off)

Links / attachments: ClearSprint_MAP_Slides_v0.2.gslides (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/clearsprint-slides-02), clearwater-eval-checklist.xlsx

Next steps: Jordan to confirm exec meeting slot (Jun 29). Emma / procurement to confirm contract cadence and any PO requirements.

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: MAP slides + condensed evaluation checklist — infra & test plan

Emma —

Quick technical confirmation from infra side: we can provision a sandbox environment with a scoped API key and 100GB ephemeral storage for the Jun 22–26 window. Key items I’ll run: 
- API smoke suite (auth, upload, inference, error states) — pass threshold: 100% on smoke tests
- Perf verification: 1-minute sustained run at expected load to collect p50/p95 (target p95 < 450ms for sample dataset)
- KV cache and seq-length profiling on your typical samples (helps us recommend batching/quantization settings)
- Data retention: sandbox logs retained 14 days; we’ll provide an export for your compliance team

I attached a short tech runbook and the test command snippets we’ll use. If your infra team wants to run any checks from their side, share SSH keys for the sandbox or we can run jointly and share logs.

Next steps / asks
- Emma: confirm stakeholder attendee list and point person for the clinical sign-off
- Procurement: confirm PO timing / contract redlines we should expect before exec meeting on Jun 29
- Jordan/Marissa: lock the exec meeting (30m) on Jun 29, ideally morning PST

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com
